MANILA, Philippines — The Supreme Court (SC) has dismissed a petition to compel the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee to release the full, unredacted draft of its partial report regarding alleged irregularities in flood-control projects nationwide.

The petition for mandamus was filed following a leak of the draft partial report to several media outlets in February. Rappler: Blue ribbon panel can’t be ordered to release draft report on flood control probe – SC.

Rappler reports that 'In this case, the SC found no constitutional or legal obligation for the committee to release an unfinished draft report,' the High Court says.

MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives on Wednesday approved on third and final reading a measure seeking to strengthen the country’s defenses against cyberattacks and protect critical infrastructure and essential services from increasingly sophisticated digital threats.

Voting 198-3-1, the House approved House Bill No. 9605, or the National Cybersecurity and Critical Information Infrastructure Protection.
